✨ AutoHedge | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To build and operate an autonomous hedge fund that automates trading strategies.
✨ Key Features: • Multi-Agent Architecture (Director, Quant, Risk Management, Execution Agents) • Real-Time Market Analysis • Risk-First Design • Structured Output (JSON) • Enterprise Logging
📖 Summary: AutoHedge is an enterprise-grade autonomous agent hedge fund that automates market analysis, risk management, and trade execution on platforms like Solana. It leverages swarm intelligence and specialized AI agents for end-to-end trading operations with minimal human intervention.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 ai-file-sorter | C++
🎯 Primary Use Case: To automatically organize and rename files on a user's computer based on their content and metadata, reducing clutter and improving findability.
✨ Key Features: • Content-aware file organization and renaming • Support for local and remote LLMs • Preview-based workflow with user control • Analysis of image content, document text, and media metadata • Cross-platform compatibility (Windows, macOS, Linux)
📖 Summary: AI File Sorter is a cross-platform desktop application designed to intelligently organize and rename files using AI. It supports both local and remote LLMs, offers a preview-based workflow for user control, and can process images, documents, audio, and video files.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 VoiceStudio | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide users with a powerful, private, and cost-effective solution for all their voice generation, cloning, and audio processing needs directly on their own hardware.
✨ Key Features: • Voice cloning and design • Video dubbing • Dictation and transcription • Audiobook creation • Support for 646 languages
📖 Summary: VoiceStudio is an open-source, local-first alternative to ElevenLabs, offering advanced voice cloning, design, and audio production tools. It supports a vast range of languages and TTS/ASR engines, running entirely on user hardware without subscriptions or API keys.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 archify | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To automatically generate verifiable, interactive architecture and system diagrams from code or descriptions, facilitating code review and system understanding.
✨ Key Features: • Generates interactive system maps from codebases or descriptions • Supports five diagram types and four presets • Offers dark/light themes and built-in brand marks
📖 Summary: Archify is a Node.js system for generating interactive architecture diagrams from codebases or system descriptions. It supports multiple diagram types and presets, offers features for reviewing architectural changes, and produces self-contained HTML files with various export options.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
